# BananaSplit

> Split expenses with friends. The expense tracking layer for humans and AI agents.

BananaSplit tracks shared expenses across vacations, roommates, couples, and group events. Data syncs across iOS, Android, web, and CLI.

## Quick Start

Install CLI:
```
curl -fsSL https://github.com/teotti/banana-cli/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
```

Sign in:
```
banana login
```

Check balances:
```
banana balance
```

## CLI Commands

- `banana balance` — show what you owe and are owed
- `banana expenses list` — list expenses
- `banana expenses add --title "Dinner" --amount 42 --currency EUR --split me=21 --split Ana=21` — add expense
- `banana payments add --amount 20 --from me --to Ana` — record payment
- `banana groups` — list groups
- `banana groups create --name "Trip" --currency EUR` — create group

Use `--json` for structured output. Use names instead of IDs.

## Agent Integration

Install skill:
```
banana skill install
```

Works with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, opencode.

Example prompts:
- "Check my BananaSplit balances"
- "Add a €42 dinner expense split with Ana"
- "Show expenses in the Lisbon trip group"

## MCP Server

URL: https://api.bananasplit.net/mcp

Connect AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT) directly via Model Context Protocol. OAuth authentication via browser.
